# Regression matrix

<!-- generated by tools/regression_matrix.py; edit regression-adjudication.yaml, not this file -->

Each requirement, accepted decision and reviewed element of the 20–24 November research, designs and graphs, traced to its disposition in the canonical packs. DeepInfra readers (MiMo-V2.6-Pro) proposed the items; a script checked every quote against its source and every reference against the packs; Claude reviewed every item marked unresolved or rejected, and overrode a disposition only with a reason (`adjudicated`). Every to-be element cited is proposed and unaccepted; *preserved* means the design carries it, not that it runs.

**Reader reliability.** Claude checked 12 reader-preserved items drawn at random (seed 7) by hand: all 12 plausible, 3 only partly carried (t1/trace-t1-16, t1/trace-t1-20, t7/trace-t7-16). Read the reader-preserved rows as likely, not certain; the adjudicated rows were each read by Claude.

**240 items proposed; 224 passed the checks:** 207 preserved, 13 deferred, 2 rejected, 2 unresolved. 16 failed a check and are listed at the end.
